name: session-dashboard
description: A side pane for the current session: prompt cache hot/cold, tool calls and errors, background commands with restart and stop, the approved plan, task list, subagents and swarm agents, and token usage for the main agent and subagents

auto_open.title: Open on start
auto_open.description: Open the dashboard pane when a session starts (it appears once the terminal is wide enough)

force_task_list.title: Ask Claude for a task list
force_task_list.description: Add a short instruction to each prompt so Claude keeps a task list the dashboard can show. Only useful on models that have the task tools (or with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1)

cache_ttl_minutes.title: Prompt cache TTL (minutes)
cache_ttl_minutes.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm. 0 picks it from how you're signed in: 60 for a subscription, 5 for an API key
